title: Mark
short: The boss carries an element, with up to three stacks.
lines: A Setter's hit leaves one. The mark strip under the boss shows each mark and its stacks.
It is the setup a Payoff cashes, not a debuff.

title: Reaction
short: A Payoff cashes a mark: bonus damage.
lines: The Payoff's element has to be strong against the mark's.
The mark loses a stack each time.
Only a Payoff's hit does it, or a Knack that says so.

title: Seal
short: This mark is not shed by the boss.
lines: Some bosses shake their marks off at the end of a turn.
A Sealed mark stays, and it can still be cashed.

title: Mired
short: A debuff on the boss: it hits softer and dodges less.
lines: It stacks up to a limit, and fades a little every round.
It is not a mark, so it sits apart from the mark strip.
It slows an Escalating boss.

title: Spend
short: Pay a cost to do something.
lines: The cost is part of a mark's stacks, a Store, or some HP.
The Knack's text says what and how much.
If the cost can't be paid, nothing happens.

title: Store
short: A small supply of a named resource on the creature.
lines: It holds up to three. What is gained past that is lost.
It starts empty each fight, and empties if the creature is knocked out.
A Knack's text says how it is gained and spent.

title: Taunt
short: The boss's plain attack aims at this creature.
lines: Only the plain attack, not the boss's named moves.
With several Taunts, the first to act draws it.

title: Intercept
short: Takes a hit meant for a creature near it.
lines: Only a creature within its Reach.
The hit is dodged first. Only a hit that lands can be intercepted.
The creature that steps in does not roll a dodge of its own.

title: Retaliate
short: Hits back when it dodges.
lines: The hit back ignores armour.
It does not hit back when it is hit.

title: Silenced
short: Its Knack, talents and role trick do nothing.
lines: A silenced Setter does not mark, a Payoff does not cash, a Guard does not cover, a Support does not boost.
Gear effects stop too. It still hits with its stats, and it does not skip its turn.

title: Boost
short: A Support's extra damage on a creature's next hit.
lines: It lasts for that one hit. It is not a lasting buff.

title: Beside
short: The living creatures in the slots on each side of it.
lines: In its own row only.
It is never widened: Reach is the part that grows.

title: Reach
short: How many slots to each side a Guard or Support covers.
lines: It starts at Beside, and some effects widen it.
It stays inside the creature’s row.

title: Row end
short: The first or last slot of its row.
lines: The slot itself, not the last creature standing in the row.
Some boss moves, like Pincer and Hush, aim at the ends.

title: Front row
short: The row nearest the boss.
lines: Not the first row that has a creature in it.

title: Area hit
short: A hit on more than one slot.
lines: It is dodged half as often.
A hit a Guard takes for you is a different thing.

title: Barrage
short: Hits several different creatures, picked at random.
lines: Drawn from the whole board.
It is not a hit on every creature of a row.

title: Leap
short: Hits one creature, then jumps to the strongest one beside it.
lines: It jumps on again and again, a little softer each time.

title: Cross
short: Hits one creature and those beside, in front of and behind it.
lines: It is not a whole row or a whole column.

title: Checker
short: Hits every other slot, like the dark squares of a board.
lines: It is not a row.

title: Most hurt
short: The creature with the lowest share of its HP left.
lines: A share, not points: a big creature at half HP is more hurt than a small one at three quarters.

title: Back-most
short: The last living creature to act.
lines: By default the right end of the back row.
It moves on as creatures are knocked out.

title: Wind-up
short: A boss move announced at the start of a round.
lines: The slots it will hit are shown, and it lands on them.
A creature knocked out before it lands is skipped.

title: Blocked
short: A hit that does not get past armour deals nothing.
lines: Armour is taken off every hit. A hit at or below it is Blocked.
It is not a dodge: the hit landed and the armour held.

title: Crit
short: A lucky hit that deals double damage to begin with.
lines: A creature's page shows its crit chance and how big its crits are.
Its Knack, talents and gear can raise both.
A boss with Double Strike crits too. A Reaction hit can crit as well.

title: Sure Crit
short: A stored crit: the next hit that lands is a sure one.
lines: A counter on the creature, built up by something that happened to it, like a dodge.
Its next hit that lands and is not already a crit spends one and is a crit.
It deals the extra of the creature that spends it, whoever gave it: some creatures crit harder than others.
It is not a Store, and not a lasting buff.

title: Escalating
short: A boss that grows as the weekend goes on.
lines: It fills from something its card names: rounds, HP lost or Reactions.
Each time it fills, the boss grows a step, up to a limit.
It carries across the weekend, and Mired slows it.
It is not a stage of the raid.

title: Determination
short: A little stronger each time the server fails this boss.
lines: From the second lap of the boss order, each failed weekend on a boss adds a little damage and healing.
It stacks up to five times, is kept over a Festival and is gone once the boss is beaten.
The chip by the boss shows how many stacks you have.

title: Setter
short: Marks the boss for a Payoff.
lines: Its hit leaves its element’s mark on the boss, or adds a stack to it.
Other roles mark only through a Knack that says so.
Act before the Payoff that cashes the mark.

title: Payoff
short: Cashes marks for bonus damage.
lines: Its hit on a mark its element is strong against sets off a Reaction.
Only a Payoff does it, or a Knack that says so.
Put it after a Setter that leaves the right mark.

title: Guard
short: Armoured. Takes hits for those beside it.
lines: A flat amount of armour comes off every hit it takes.
If the dodge fails, a hit aimed at a creature in its Reach lands on the Guard instead.
Area hits and Wind-ups pass it by, unless a Knack says otherwise.

title: Support
short: Boosts and heals those beside it.
lines: At the start of each round it boosts or heals the creatures in its Reach.
Its Reach stays inside its row.
A knocked-out or silenced Support gives nothing.

title: Soaked
short: Tide’s mark. Spark cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Setter’s Tide hit.
Hit again, it gains a stack, up to three.
A Spark Payoff’s hit sets off Overload and takes a stack off it.
Some bosses shed their marks at the end of a turn.

title: Charged
short: Spark’s mark. Grove cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Setter’s Spark hit.
Hit again, it gains a stack, up to three.
A Grove Payoff’s hit sets off Grounding and takes a stack off it.
Some bosses shed their marks at the end of a turn.

title: Overgrown
short: Grove’s mark. Ember cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Setter’s Grove hit.
Hit again, it gains a stack, up to three.
A Ember Payoff’s hit sets off Wildfire and takes a stack off it.
Some bosses shed their marks at the end of a turn.

title: Muddied
short: Mire’s mark. Ember cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Setter’s Mire hit.
Hit again, it gains a stack, up to three.
A Ember Payoff’s hit sets off Flare and takes a stack off it.
Some bosses shed their marks at the end of a turn.

title: Scorched
short: Ember’s mark. Tide or Mire cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Setter’s Ember hit.
Hit again, it gains a stack, up to three.
A Tide Payoff’s hit sets off Steam, a Mire Payoff’s Smother. Each takes a stack off it.
Some bosses shed their marks at the end of a turn.

title: Overload
short: Spark on Soaked: bonus damage.
lines: A Payoff’s Spark hit on a Soaked boss sets it off.
It deals bonus damage, and a crit makes the bonus bigger.
It takes a stack off the mark.
Only a Payoff does it, or a Knack that says so.

title: Grounding
short: Grove on Charged: bonus damage.
lines: A Payoff’s Grove hit on a Charged boss sets it off.
It deals bonus damage, and a crit makes the bonus bigger.
It takes a stack off the mark.
Only a Payoff does it, or a Knack that says so.

title: Wildfire
short: Ember on Overgrown: bonus damage.
lines: A Payoff’s Ember hit on a Overgrown boss sets it off.
It deals bonus damage, and a crit makes the bonus bigger.
It takes a stack off the mark.
Only a Payoff does it, or a Knack that says so.

title: Steam
short: Tide on Scorched: bonus damage.
lines: A Payoff’s Tide hit on a Scorched boss sets it off.
It deals bonus damage, and a crit makes the bonus bigger.
It takes a stack off the mark.
Only a Payoff does it, or a Knack that says so.

title: Smother
short: Mire on Scorched: bonus damage.
lines: A Payoff’s Mire hit on a Scorched boss sets it off.
It deals bonus damage, and a crit makes the bonus bigger.
It takes a stack off the mark.
Only a Payoff does it, or a Knack that says so.

title: Flare
short: Ember on Muddied: bonus damage.
lines: A Payoff’s Ember hit on a Muddied boss sets it off.
It deals bonus damage, and a crit makes the bonus bigger.
It takes a stack off the mark.
Only a Payoff does it, or a Knack that says so.

title: Tide
short: Water. Strong against Ember.
lines: Hits Ember bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Spark bosses for 25% less damage.
Hits Mire bosses for 25% less damage.
Tide Setter hits leave Soaked on the boss. Spark cashes it in.

title: Ember
short: Fire. Strong against Grove and Mire.
lines: Hits Grove bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Mire bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Tide bosses for 25% less damage. Mire hits it for 50% more.
Ember Setter hits leave Scorched on the boss. Tide or Mire cashes it in.

title: Grove
short: Plants. Strong against Spark.
lines: Hits Spark bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Ember bosses for 25% less damage.
Grove Setter hits leave Overgrown on the boss. Ember cashes it in.

title: Spark
short: Lightning. Strong against Tide.
lines: Hits Tide bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Grove bosses for 25% less damage.
Spark Setter hits leave Charged on the boss. Grove cashes it in.

title: Mire
short: Mud and bog. Strong against Ember.
lines: Hits Ember bosses for 50% more damage.
Ember hits Mire bosses for 50% more. Tide hits them for 25% less.
Mire Setter hits leave Muddied on the boss. Ember cashes it in.

title: Boss Rank
short: How far along the boss order the server is.
lines: The bosses come in a fixed order, and the Rank counts how far along it is.
Beat the boss and the server moves on to the next one, a Rank higher.
A boss you did not beat comes back next week at full HP.

title: Festival
short: Every 5th week: a week without a raid.
lines: Every 5th raid week is a Festival.
The boss order waits, and nothing is lost or eased.
A boss you had not beaten comes back at full HP afterwards.

title: Knack
short: A trick a creature carries into the raid.
lines: Each creature carries one Knack, picked on its page from the ones its form knows.
It is locked once the creature has fought this weekend.
Knacks take the place of the old finale abilities.

title: Level
short: Higher level, stronger creature.
lines: A creature levels up from experience: trips, the dungeon, raids and Workshop jobs.
Each level adds HP, Attack and Speed.
A creature waits at level 10 and 20 for a ribbon, and at 15 until it evolves. The top is 30.

title: Resisted
short: From stage 2 the boss resists what did most damage.
lines: The element, or the Reaction, with the most damage so far is resisted.
Its creatures hit for less. It is shown at the stage break.
It starts fresh each week. A tie gives no resistance.
